10 Animal Picture Quizzes

Table of Contents

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 8:20
Instaread

Quizzes never sounded like a fun activity until we came along! We have a ton of quizzes on our Just Family Fun website, like our True Or Total Nonsense? and Would You Rather? quizzes. Not only are these fun but they’re also great learning activities that prompt good discussion between you and the kids.

Here, we have our free animal identification quizzes that kids are sure to enjoy. Let them guess the animals first and then go over the answer sheets with them to see how many they got right. Maybe they can even earn a special prize if they get them all!

Kids Love Learning About Animals

Kids are naturally drawn to animals because of their kind, nonjudgmental, and entertaining nature. From a young age, we’re wired to love animals of all kinds. They’re cute, fun, and pretty fascinating when you actually take the time to learn about them.

Our quizzes focus on identifying animals by their different parts. Kids will have fun guessing the animals based on their eyes, noses, shadows, and more. There are plenty of learning opportunities that these quizzes provide too. There’s a ton of possible activities you can do with them so get creative with it!

What’s Included In Our 10 Animal Picture Quizzes

Each of our downloads comes with two pages – one for the quiz and one answer sheet. You can download and print as many copies and as many different quizzes as you want. They’re all free and easily accessible! And each quiz has a different set of animals to keep the kids’ brains working.

Guess The Animal Eye Quiz

When kids look into an animal’s eyes, they get to connect with them. Kids will love this Animal Eye Quiz not only because it’s fun but also because it’ll make them feel like a friend is looking right back at them. Maybe they’ll even see the family pet looking at them! Talk to kids about the different colors and other features of eyes throughout the animal kingdom.

Download Quiz

Guess The Animal Feet Quiz

Animal feet are just adorable! There’s really no other way to put it. And the really cool thing is that animals have so many different kinds of feet for kids to identify! You can even help them learn why their feet look the way they do based on what they need them for.

Download Quiz

Guess The Animal Nose Quiz

Noses are just as cute! Kids will giggle and fall in love as they practice identifying animal noses. And, like feet, some animals use their noses for different tasks. You can talk to kids about the various anatomy and why noses are shaped the way they are. They’ll especially love the elephant trunk!

Download Quiz

Guess The Animal Pattern Quiz

We all love animal patterns. They show up in our clothes, binder covers, and so much more. Kids can do this quiz to learn which markings belong to which animals. Then, they can go through their things to see which animal patterns show up. You can also ask them about their favorite pattern and teach them how to draw it.

Download Quiz

Guess The Animal Shadow Quiz

This is one of our easier animal quizzes perfect for younger children! Kids can guess the animal based on the shadow. Then, for added fun, they can try to draw the animal on a different piece of paper. Younger kids may need help with that part. But they’ll still have tons of fun even if their own creation looks nothing like the animal should!

Download Quiz

Guess The Animal Tail Quiz

Kids love looking at animal tails because they’re so unique. They enjoy seeing the various shapes, sizes, and textures the tails come in. Some are long, some are short. Some are fluffy, some are smooth, and some even have hard scales. Like with the Animal Feet Quiz, you can take this opportunity to teach kids about why they have different features.

Download Quiz

Guess The Baby Animal Quiz

Baby animals bring joy no matter who you are! Some of them look just like mini versions of their parents and others look quite different. After your kids identify the babies correctly, you can teach them about what different baby animals are called.

Download Quiz

Guess The Farm Animal Quiz

Farm animals are usually some of the first ones kids learn about thanks to the songs and fairytales they grow up with. And every kid has a favorite farm animal too! When they’re done with the quiz, you can talk to the kids about what the animals do on the farm, like giving us milk and eggs.

Download Quiz

Guess The Insect Quiz

Kids love insects, even when we find them to be creepy. So, kids will absolutely love this insect identifying activity. It’s also pretty cool to see their little faces up close since we’re usually too busy swatting at them or running away! When they’re done with the quiz, take them out to the backyard and see if they can find the insects they just guessed (with supervision of course).

Download Quiz

Guess The Sea Creature Quiz

The ocean is wildly fascinating to kids and adults of all ages. We don’t get to see it in our daily life so this will be brand new to your kids. Like our other animal quizzes, the Sea Creature Quiz also gives you a wonderful opportunity to talk to kids about the many types of bodies the animal kingdom has, especially the underwater one!

Download Quiz

Fun Ways to Enjoy Our Quizzes

Our quizzes can be used by parents, teachers, and other caregivers in many ways. Here are some suggestions to get you started!

Quiz And Characters

It’s a known fact that kids love cartoons almost as much as they love animals. A fun way to get them even more excited to learn about animals is connecting our quizzes to their favorite movies and cartoons. After they’ve finished a quiz, ask them to list different characters that are the same animal as the ones pictured. Then, they can imagine their favorite characters as they learn!

Trip To The Zoo

Every kid loves going to see the animals in real life. As you’re headed to the zoo, farm, petting zoo, animal rescue, etc., have them fill out the worksheets in the car. Then, see if they can recognize the animals once they see them for real. Our Guess The Sea Creature Quiz can also be used for this activity as you’re headed to the aquarium.

Animal Science

Kids sometimes hear the word “science” and are immediately turned off. Not every kid will love school and learning activities. But now you have a fun way to pique their interest. Before starting a science lesson at home or school, give them one of our quizzes to fill out. Then, they’ll have fun finding out if they got the right answers while they also learn facts about the different animals.

Favorite Animals

Kids all have a favorite animal. These quizzes can help prompt this talk and give kids the motivation to learn more about their favorite animal. Talk to them about their living environment, behaviors, body features, and more.

Picture Quizzes For Kids FAQ

What Age Group Are These Animal Picture Quizzes For?

Early elementary kids (ages 5-6) will be able to do these with an adult’s help. Older kids (ages 7+) should be able to do them independently but may still need some assistance. These worksheets are best for elementary kids.

Are There Any Limits To What I Can Print?

Nope! You can print as many of our Animal Picture Quizzes and other worksheets from Just Family Fun all for free!

Can These Be Used Together Or With Other Worksheets?

The Animal Picture Quizzes have some animals that repeat. You can have kids guess the animals and guess which pictures go together. We also have other quizzes, activities, and coloring pages that would pair well with these quizzes such as our Animal Face Mask Templates.

Can I Print On Any Kind Of Paper?

These quizzes are best used on regular printer paper. However, as long as you select “Letter” size when you print, you can use whatever paper your printer can take.

Are These Good For Teachers To Use?

These are a GREAT tool for teachers to use in the classroom. They can be used as an introductory activity, lesson winddown, or free time fun. Kids will learn without even realizing they’re learning!

More Fun Picture Quizzes for Kids

If your kids enjoyed these Animal Picture Quizzes, we have plenty more that they’ll love too! Two other very popular ones are our Kids Picture Quizzes and Landmark Picture Quiz.

Our Kids Picture Quizzes have a variety of themes for your youngster to learn about – other animals, fruit, vehicles, sports, and more. And, with the fantastic Quizby there to guide them, fun and learning will become one!

Social Studies is another core school subject that kids can sometimes be wary of. Like our animal quizzes, our Landmark Picture Quiz is a great way to introduce kids to famous places and get them interested in learning. This quiz features landmarks from the United States and all around the world!
